Packages a file needs

Source: R/scan.R
rds_deps.Rd

Lists what loading a file would need from outside it: the namespaces and package environments it refers to, the packages of its ALTREP classes, and the packages of its S4 classes. The file is not loaded.

Usage

rds_deps(x, kind = NULL)

Arguments

x

A path, a raw vector (a serialize() result, or a file's bytes) or a connection open for reading in binary mode. For a lazy-load database, the path without extension, as lazyLoad() takes it, or the path of its .rdb or .rdx file.

kind

NULL to detect the kind of file, or one of "rds", "rda" and "lazyload" to insist on it.

Value

A data frame with one row per distinct need:

  • package: the package's name.

  • reason: "namespace", "package_environment", "altrep" or "s4".

  • detail: the ALTREP or S4 class, or NA.

See also

Other safety: rds_scan()

Examples

rds_deps(system.file("extdata", "model.rds", package = "zurds"))
#> [1] package reason  detail 
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)

# An object from a namespace needs that package:
rds_deps(serialize(stats::sd, NULL))
#>   package    reason detail
#> 1   stats namespace   <NA>
